Freshteam, Smart HR Software for Growing Businesses from Freshworks.
Freshteam is the HR suite of Freshworks, a SaaS unicorn from India. Freshteam started its journey as an Applicant Tracking System, enabling recruiters worldwide to streamline their hiring process. After seeing the substantial change it can bring to the HR community, Freshteam spread its wings and now becomes a complete HR solution.
Freshteam takes care of Onboarding, Timeoff Management, Employee Information, and Offboarding problems besides solving many recruitment challenges for growing businesses. With a rich 5000+ customer base, Freshteam strives to develop a product that makes HR's life easier, making them a strategic business unit and not a team stuck with mundane tasks.
